description: This Java class is an abstract base class for query signal mappers within the Eclipse Ditto project's protocol adapter module. It extends another abstract class and defines supported actions for query commands, specifically handling the 'RETRIEVE' action.

classes.name: AbstractQuerySignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for query signal mappers that handle retrieval commands within the Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns the array of supported actions, specifically indicating that this mapper supports the 'RETRIEVE' action.
